name: Gelidus
tagline: The operating standard for personal cold immersion.
positioning: Gelidus runs precision cold-plunge studios for individuals who treat recovery like a discipline. Reserve a chamber, log every session, own your protocol.

hero.sub: Gelidus studios hold water at a certified 3.2°C with lab-grade filtration. Book a chamber, run your protocol, and export a signed session record every single time.

features.title: Certified thermal control
features.description: Every chamber is held at 3.2°C ±0.2 with continuous logging. No guesswork, no lukewarm plunges, no manual thermostat fiddling before you get in.

features.title: Protocol library
features.description: Load a structured immersion protocol — duration, breath cadence, exposure count — straight to the chamber console before your session begins.

features.title: Signed session records
features.description: Each plunge produces a timestamped, tamper-evident record with water temp, duration, and heart-rate deltas. Export to PDF or your health app.

features.title: Reservations that hold
features.description: Reserve a specific chamber at a specific minute. If a unit falls out of spec, we rebook you automatically and credit the session.

features.title: Studio-grade hygiene
features.description: UV and mechanical filtration cycle between every guest, with published water chemistry logs posted to your account after each visit.

features.title: Progress tracking
features.description: Streaks, cold-tolerance trends, and cumulative exposure minutes, charted across every Gelidus location you've ever visited.

testimonials.quote: The signed session records changed how I train. I hand my physiotherapist a clean export instead of scribbled notes, and she actually adjusts my program from real data now.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feldt

testimonials.quote: I've used three plunge chains. Gelidus is the only one that holds temperature to spec every session. The consistency alone is worth the flat rate.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: Booking a specific chamber at a specific minute, with automatic rebooking when a unit drifts, is embarrassingly rare. Gelidus just treats it as table stakes.
testimonials.name: Tobias Renner
